# kimi hook payloads

Shaped exactly as Kimi Code CLI builds them (`src/kimi_cli/hooks/events.py` in
MoonshotAI/kimi-cli: `hook_event_name`, `session_id`, `cwd`, then each event's
own fields) — not yet seen live. A payload captured from a real session on your
machine is the most useful contribution: see CONTRIBUTING › Add or fix a tool.
